a1.title: The Narrow Beam
a1.note: the shy one now trusts patient half-light: seven earned stars complete a constellation; staring still loses

b1.title: Didn't You Notice
b1.note: misses now teach: twin decoys hold the eye, changes land where you were just looking, the pace breathes

c1.title: One Thing
c1.note: the rhythm breaks off: from round 4 the eye and ear disagree in time until the gold spark comes home

d1.title: Seeing With Your Ears
d1.note: tap and hold still: sonar now answers — walls knock, the voice sings back, the twin's burr betrays it; stars persist

a2.title: Trust the Feeling
a2.note: trust deepens: the mark tightens and the cue recedes with each right guess; every ninth commit mirrors your hesitation

b2.title: Below the Line
b2.note: the pushes now sink below notice in tiers, a noise-mouth almost says the word, and the clock tells who obeyed faster

c2.title: The Guessing Machine
c2.note: overconfidence now hallucinates whole beats — bright, painless, false — revealed only in pale retrospect

d2.title: What Red Sounds Like
d2.note: two minds now: pass the phone and a friend shapes what they hear; seven crossings end in a coda of every doomed translation

a3.title: Where I End
a3.note: the wide body breathes under its heartbeat, sour parts drain visibly bile-green, and mass slows the border's wobble

b3.title: Two Minds
b3.note: the speaker now commits before it's caught: blind rounds get a smug assertion, then the mute hand's correction

c3.title: The Inward Ear
c3.note: depth now lengthens the breath itself, and staying past the last milestone earns the coda: let go, just listen

d3.title: Who You Were
d3.note: two threads now: beads whisper their dates, long selves recall in two breaths, and the gardener's own motif arcs faintly above

a4.title: The Width of Now
a4.note: playable time-grain toy: drag the band to stretch the moment; beats fuse into chords or shatter into a line

b4.title: Did I Do That?
b4.note: playable authorship probe: nine moves, one question; the reveal maps which feelings of 'I did that' lied

c4.title: The River
c4.note: playable stream of consciousness: hold one thought and it completes itself; the rest wash by unheard

d4.title: Catch Yourself
d4.note: playable mind-wandering mirror: tap the pulse, drift detunes the drone; the catch is the score
